what: A circle-cropped photo cross-fades to the next year every 5 seconds over 1.4s, a giant year number straddling the circle’s edge rises letter by letter, 90ms apart, from 1em below over .8s, and the outer arc is drawn linearly by one year’s step over 5 seconds (it stops at the last year, then rewinds by one step when looping back to the start). It starts running once it is on screen.

options.every: Interval to move to the next year (s), default 5
options.--fx-year-size·--fx-year-left: Year text size (default 10.4rem) · position overhanging outside the circle (default -21.5%)
options.[data-fx-part=slide·photo·year·arc]: One slide per year containing a round photo (photo) and year text (year, text only), and one arc path (arc) anywhere in the panel

note: The original uses the site’s own intervalChange and splitText modules, so the same behavior was rebuilt (curves and durations are the original --transition-slider and --transition-splittext values)

from.where: index.html .kg-archive__figure — original .pg-top-archive__figure (intervalChange intervalSpeed 5000, arc stroke-dashoffset linear 5000ms, splitText delayChange 90)
